description: Replace naive calendar-day addition with business-day addition that skips weekends and is exact for any starting weekday
prompts: dates.js's addBusinessDays(start, n) just adds n calendar days in milliseconds - it counts weekends as business days. Implement it properly: n=0 returns a Date equal to start unchanged (even if start itself falls on a weekend); for n>0, step forward day by day, skipping Saturdays (getDay()===6) and Sundays (getDay()===0), until n business days have been counted, then return that Date. It must be exact for any starting weekday and correctly cross month/year boundaries - do not use an approximation formula like `n + 2*Math.floor(n/5)` calendar-days shortcut, it gives the wrong answer depending on which weekday `start` falls on. Treat all dates as UTC to avoid timezone drift.
name: add_js_business_day_date_math
